July 26, 1979

The Honorable Dawson Mathis
United States House of Representatives
Washington, D.C.

Dear Representative Mathis:

Reference is made to your telegram of July 24, 1979, which was received at our New York Office on the afternoon of July 25th, inquiring as to prices on the flue-cured tobacco market.
I am advised that very limited quantities of tobacco have thus far been marketed which meet Lorillard's quality requirements. I am also told that past experience demonstrates that as improvements occur in the quality of the tobacco being offered, price responses frequently follow.

85679292

(

I regret that we cannot supply any more detailed information, but as you can appreciate, your question relates to confidential business information of a highly competitive nature which cannot be the subject of public discussion.

Respectfully.

AJS/wrh

Arthur J. Stevens
Senior Vice President
